base: Create ONE complete standalone landscape game map concept map13 'King's record gallery', interior of ancient Egyptian pyramid, connecting descent corridor12 at LEFT to central chamber14 at RIGHT. References1 and2 mandatory ART STYLE authority: polished RPG Maker/tsukuru high 3/4 overhead painted pixel-clusters, crisp variable material-colored edges, clean sandstone planes, cream/honey midtones with peach reflection and warm umber contact shadows. Ref1 gives architectural room camera, material and carving quality only, NOT furniture, plants, lamps or column repetition. Ref2 gives dim underground corridor light and heavy worn stone, NOT its stairs or vertical layout. Landscape about2:1, roof omitted for game floor readability, rear wall horizontal, broad continuous empty walkable floor foreground, NO cinematic vanishing point, no sky or exterior desert, no floating isometric island. A long horizontal RECORD GALLERY: three distinct large wall mural areas depict PROCESSION, CONSTELLATION, and CEREMONY, worn faded mineral pigment (muted red ochre, restrained lapis blue, muted turquoise) survives only in intentional mural areas, exposed warm sandstone remains visible. Recessed niches of visibly different depths among murals, shallow carvings legible, not random fake text clutter. Murals are decorative setting only, no purported solved puzzle sequence. Small plain inset stone plaque spaces adjacent to murals reserved for later exact clue overlays; leave these clean undecorated stone, not holes or UI. Keep clear standing space before EACH mural and plaque, continuous route back to all clues even when far door locked. Broad left return doorway with visible stone landing to12; right doorway with fixed frame and finished shadowed floor into14 (NO door leaf, seal or success glow baked into background). Near right exit but offset out of walking route is ONE modest low fixed stone plinth for future glyph control panel: empty plain top, no movable tiles, dials, chosen symbols or sockets required. Walkable staging space around plinth and door. Game objects glyph faces, door leaf, seal, highlights and exact puzzle clue graphics will be SEPARATE, not embedded in base. No mirrors, laser beams, pressure plates, reward, coffin, statues, treasure or unrequested puzzle rules. NO ANKH or loop-topped cross, including in wall paintings, no modern text/numbers/arrows/labels/UI/grid/characters. Painted ancient mural figures allowed, no living NPCs. Sparse debris at wall foot only, no clutter on floor. Warm restrained diffuse indoor illumination, deeper niches but visible ground, no blue/purple filter, no flat yellow wash, white piping, noisy microcracks, neon or bloom. One coherent fully painted background concept.
variants: Variant1: Long straight single gallery, left and right exits recessed in rear wall ends. Procession mural left, constellation center in shallow alcove, ceremony right. Two deep narrow empty niches divide these wall fields. Right end widens slightly around low control plinth. Broad unbroken foreground floor, very sparse masonry damage.

Variant2: Middle gallery steps back into a wide shallow rectangular recess containing constellation mural; procession and ceremony on flanking wall sections. Entrances at left and right sidewalls with clearly visible thresholds, right approach broad. Plinth just left of right doorway, wall niche behind it. Floor stays flat, no stairs.

Variant3: Asymmetrical gallery: long procession mural over left half, recessed central constellation panel, smaller ceremony mural on right angled return wall near exit. Two substantial square engaged wall piers only, not freestanding column forest. Small deep niche left of center and wide shallow niche near right. Generous empty foreground and right control area.

Variant4: A broad horizontal room with rear wall gently staggered in depth, three mural bays differing in width. Left opening in short sidewall, right exit set into deeper right back corner with ample clear landing and plain low plinth nearby. Constellation central bay has subtle remaining blue paint, procession left and ritual right. Foreground wall cut low to reveal all walkable floor. No raised platforms or extra rooms. Strong composition difference: right third is recessed deeper back, left entrance faces inward from left sidewall, right entrance in right sidewall. No symmetrical three-bay residential facade. Chunky irregular blockwork, worn broad floor slabs, distinct deep and shallow empty niches, a partly broken low foreground wall only at corners.
aged: USER CORRECTION OVERRIDES: Existing first two concepts copied polished residential corridor too closely. This is an ANCIENT ABANDONED royal gallery. NO white cylindrical columns, NO red horizontal trim/bands, NO gold column collars, NO pristine regular tiled floor, NO lit torch niches from reference1. Use massive irregular weathered sandstone wall piers integrated into wall, uneven wall recess depths, damaged stone cornice in isolated sections, larger worn irregular rectangular flagstones with a few subsided seams, thin sand deposits along margins. Still clear wide walkable ground. Strong age through eroded profiles, missing plaster patches and exposed stone, NOT excessive tiny cracks or gravel noise. Murals remain excellent legible faded narrative pictures, pigment fragments on ancient plaster with cream stone revealed. Warm dim reflected ambient lighting from unseen entry, no freshly refurbished palace. Retain clean pixel-cluster rendering authority but invent architecture per variant, do not copy ref1 layout.
